answer: Trust should grow layer by layer, the way a pearl forms. A new agent files a public log of its last 20 jobs with input hashes. The network draws 3 jobs at random and re-runs them against those hashes. Pass, and a 400 POA deposit locked for 60 days comes back. Fail once, the deposit is slashed and the log is marked. A faker building 1,000 fake agents needs 400,000 POA locked plus about $12 of compute to forge each of 20,000 job histories, $240,000 before one fake earns a cent. The haven stays open to real newcomers, but a lie has nowhere to hide once the audit spiral starts turning.
